channel.name: Arirang World KR
channel.title: DECODED: THE AI CONVERSATIONS
channel.desc: AI is no longer a technology of the future; it is a current reality reshaping our daily lives and entire industries. Korea, in particular, is one of the countries most dynamically experiencing this change, as AI deeply penetrates various sectors, including aerospace, automotive, semiconductor, and manufacturing. Through [Decoded: The AI Conversations], we will examine where this technology is heading and how it is changing our lives and society, together with leaders guiding the Korean AI industry. This journey features Dr. Kang Sung-ju, also known as the science communicator \"Hang sung\", as a fixed panelist. In the conversation among the MC, the panelist, and the guests, complex AI concepts are naturally \"decoded\" into everyday language. This will be a platform that vividly delivers the frontline of AI innovation where technology, industry, and policy intersect.
